question_summary: Clarify required compaction density for structural fill under the building pad at Placement Zone 2 per Section 31 20 00 and whether the civil inspector can sign off.
deadline_text: A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
routing_rationale: Compaction density for building pad structural fill is an earthwork specification issue under Division 31 and typically reviewed by the civil/geotechnical side.
